body.label: Target
body.html: Enemies in a sphere of radius 1 centered within 5 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, each target is Distracted until the start of your next turn. Independently, three chosen spaces in the area provide concealment until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Reposition one chosen shadow space to an adjacent empty space.
One hit target takes 1 Arcane Damage.

rider.title: Shadow Thread
rider.html: Gain a Shadow Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: after resolving, choose two adjacent spaces within 3 units; they provide concealment until the start of your next turn.
